# Third-party assets in vendor/

These files are served from this site rather than from Google Fonts, cdnjs or
jsDelivr, so a visit does not disclose the visitor IP address to those
providers (LG München, 3 O 17493/20, 20 Jan 2022).

Downloaded by `scripts/vendor.sh` on 2026-11-08.
